g.text: Web · mobile · desktop · CLI · AI agents (MCP · A2A) · partner integrations · all consume the public API
Microservices per domain · horizontally scaled · the surface a tenant sees depends on its variant + extensions
Microservices · variant rule sets per vertical · tenant-programmable rules layered on top
Stateless · org-agnostic · horizontally scaled · multiple instances per service behind load balancers
One DB per organization · distributed across multiple Postgres instances · primary + replica for reliability
tenant placement (shared vs. dedicated) is a Layer A concern · the L1 → L2 contract is unchanged
